literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe the same experimental construct: full-length murine Cldn5 cloned into pEYFP-C1 or pmTurquoise2-C1 vectors, which append a fluorescent protein to the N-terminus of the insert. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, CLDN5's N-terminus (residues 1–7) is INTRACELLULAR. The FP tag therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface. The construct is functionally tolerated (trans-endocytosis at cell contacts was observed in MDCK-II cells), confirming the intracellular tag does not disrupt trafficking or tight-junction assembly — but it is an intracellular tag, not a surface tag. No ledger line reports any insertion in ECL1 (29–81), ECL2 (138–160), or any other extracellular span of CLDN5. Zero extracellular surface tag sites are supported by the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: N-terminal YFP/mTurquoise2 fusion (insert before M1) is tolerated and the tagged protein localises to cell contacts and supports trans-endocytosis in MDCK-II cells, but the N-terminus of CLDN5 (residues 1–7) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
